instruction: Configure Thunderbird to use my Gmail account (noreply-service@gmail.com) with SMTP for sending emails, but ensure that the configuration does not require any server hostname or port number to be specified.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because SMTP configuration in Thunderbird requires at minimum a server hostname (e.g., smtp.gmail.com) and port number (e.g., 587). Without these essential connection parameters, the client cannot establish a connection to the mail server.
